turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am less afraid of losing my job now that the four-day week is settled.
What went through your mind then?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. That is how it was.
And how was that for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
And how was that for you?
The guilt about the nursing home is still there, it sits in my chest.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I keep coming back to it.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Tell me more about that.
I registered for the charity race at Roundhay Park on the fourteenth of June.
What happened next?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. Yes, it was like that.
Tell me more about that.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
How did that feel for you?
Hannah and I had an argument at the airport because she thinks I am exaggerating how bad Dad is.
What went through your mind then?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Tell me more about that.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
